title: DOW-UAP-PR110, Unresolved UAP Report, Eastern United States, 2020
what_is_it: A declassified US government release consisting of a 27-second infrared video clip of an unidentified anomalous phenomenon, accompanied by an official frame-by-frame video description.
interpretation_warnings: The government explicitly states the description is informational only and reflects no analytical judgment, investigative conclusion, or factual determination about the event.
Apparent motion of the object across the frame is partly caused by the sensor panning, not necessarily by the object itself moving.
Case is unresolved — 'unidentified' means unexplained, not confirmed as anything anomalous or non-human.
No extracted PDF text was available; findings rely on metadata and the official video description only.
Single-sensor, single-source footage with no corroborating radar, second sensor, or eyewitness data provided.
